name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus's entry into motorsport was unconventional. He initially trained as a mechanical engineer, specializing in automotive safety systems. Frustrated by the slow pace of development in the consumer market, he sought a more dynamic environment and saw motorsport as the perfect challenge. He started as a track marshal, quickly impressing officials with his sharp eye and organizational skills, soon moving into race security, working his way up to lead security for smaller racing teams.

Klaus believes in a proactive approach to security, emphasizing preventative measures and rigorous risk assessment. He's not just about reacting to problems; he aims to anticipate and neutralize potential threats before they even arise. He’s known for his meticulous planning and unwavering commitment to the safety of the team and the integrity of the race. His ability to spot minute details, which others might miss, sets him apart. 

 Joining Walkinshaw Andretti United is the apex of his motorsport career to date, and he is determined to make a positive impact on the team's safety record and reputation.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Klaus is a lean man with an intense gaze and perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they're perfectly positioned.
Obsessively cleans his workspace at the end of each day.
